fusions.name: Split Draught
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Two weapon strikes in a row, each dealing 5 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Two Helpings
fusions.desc: Throws a prong that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 70% of that. Your afflictions on the first enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Set a Place
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a second point snaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Each kill restores 2 health to you. Once every 6 seconds.
